name: Rift bomber
description: a small hot-pink imp of the Cracked Road with bat wings and a satchel of round black bombs with burning fuses, shimmering at the edges as if half in another place

poses.stand: hovering with the satchel of bombs at its hip, edges shimmering, facing right
poses.struck: struck: bomb satchel jolted, shimmer flaring pink, squinting
poses.dead: burst into a scatter of pink sparks and a dropped empty satchel

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
